b: Madonna, SZA and Giorgio Moroder are among the artists playing next year's festival in California
Coachella has revealed its full 2027 lineup.

The California festival will be headlined by SZA, Dua Lipa and Tame Impala, while Madonna is also listed to play a special set in the Sahara dance music tent, following a 2006 appearance she did there after putting out her album Confessions On A Dance Floor. Next year’s set will come after the release this past summer of that album’s sequel.

Also listed to play Coachella are Giorgio Moroder, Underworld, Four Tet, Weezer, Kelela, Shygirl, Steve Lacy, Social Distortion, Boy Harsher, underscores and Chanel Beads, among many others. Justice are scheduled to debut a new project titled Blinded By The Lights too.
Coachella will take place from 9 to 11 and 16 to 18 April 2027. Find more information here.
